question_text: Write the molecular formula of the first two members of the homologous series having functional group -Cl.

options.label: A
options.text: CH3Cl, C2H4Cl

options.label: B
options.text: CH3Cl, C2H5Cl

options.label: C
options.text: CH4Cl, C2H6Cl

options.label: D
options.text: CHCl3, C2Cl6

explanation: The general formula for the homologous series with -Cl is CnH2n+1Cl. For n=1, it's CH3Cl. For n=2, it's C2H5Cl.

options.label: B
options.text: Fragmentation, Asexual

options.label: C

options.label: D

explanation: Under favorable conditions, Spirogyra reproduces by fragmentation, which is an asexual method.

question_text: An object is placed at a distance of 30 cm in front of a convex mirror of focal length 15 cm. Which of the following describes the image formed?

options.label: A
options.text: Real, inverted, and diminished

options.label: B
options.text: Virtual, erect, and magnified

options.label: C
options.text: Virtual, erect, and diminished

options.label: D
options.text: Real, erect, and same size

explanation: Using the mirror formula 1/f = 1/v + 1/u, with u = -30 cm and f = 15 cm, we find v = 10 cm. Since v is positive, the image is virtual and erect. Magnification m = -v/u = -10/-30 = 1/3, so the image is diminished.

question_text: What is sustainable management? Which of the following is a reason why reuse is considered better than recycling?

options.label: A
options.text: Sustainable management is exploiting resources rapidly; Reuse requires more energy than recycling.

options.label: B
options.text: Sustainable management is using resources efficiently for the future; Reuse saves energy and prevents pollution.

options.label: C
options.text: Sustainable management is ignoring resource conservation; Reuse creates more waste.

options.label: D
options.text: Sustainable management is focusing on individual gains; Reuse is more expensive.

explanation: Sustainable management aims to conserve resources for the future. Reuse is better because it saves energy and prevents environmental pollution compared to recycling.

question_text: Why is the management of forest and wildlife resources a challenging task? Choose the most appropriate reasons.

options.label: A
options.text: Only the government is involved; there are no conflicting interests.

options.label: B
options.text: There are many stakeholders with conflicting interests; industries lobby for raw materials at low rates.

options.label: C
options.text: Forests are easy to manage; wildlife populations are always stable.

options.label: D
options.text: There is a single, unified approach to forest management; resources are unlimited.

explanation: Management is challenging because of the many stakeholders with conflicting interests and the lobbying by industries for cheap raw materials.

question_text: Two carbon compounds X and Y have the molecular formula C4H8 and C5H12 respectively. Which one of these is most likely to show addition reaction?

options.label: A
options.text: X (C4H8) because it is a saturated compound.

options.label: B
options.text: Y (C5H12) because it is an unsaturated compound.

options.label: C
options.text: X (C4H8) because it is an unsaturated compound.

options.label: D
options.text: Y (C5H12) because it is a saturated compound.

explanation: C4H8 is an alkene (unsaturated) and will show addition reactions. C5H12 is an alkane (saturated) and will not.

question_text: Which of the following correctly completes the chemical equation: Fe + CuSO4 → ?

options.label: A
options.text: Cu + FeSO4

options.label: B
options.text: Fe2(SO4)3 + Cu

options.label: C
options.text: No reaction

options.label: D
options.text: FeS + CuO4

explanation: Iron is more reactive than copper, so it displaces copper from copper sulfate, forming iron sulfate and copper.

question_text: What are the vertical columns and horizontal rows in the Modern Periodic Table called, respectively? How does metallic character change down a group?

options.label: A
options.text: Periods and Groups; Metallic character decreases.

options.label: B
options.text: Groups and Periods; Metallic character increases.

options.label: C
options.text: Families and Series; Metallic character remains constant.

options.label: D
options.text: Series and Families; Metallic character decreases.

explanation: Vertical columns are called groups, and horizontal rows are periods. Metallic character increases down a group because the atomic size increases, and the outermost electrons are more easily lost.

question_text: How does the size of the atomic radius vary on moving from left to right in a horizontal row (period) of the periodic table?

options.label: A
options.text: Increases due to increasing number of shells.

options.label: B
options.text: Decreases due to increasing nuclear charge.

options.label: C
options.text: Remains constant.

options.label: D
options.text: Increases due to decreasing nuclear charge.

explanation: Atomic radius decreases from left to right in a period because the nuclear charge increases, pulling the electrons closer to the nucleus.
